data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'najjana', which means 'to save, help, or be saved'. In Islamic contexts, Munji is a name given to a child who is considered a blessing and a source of joy and protection for his parents. The name Munji carries the meaning “Saved, Helped” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munji usually hope their child will grow to embody saved, helped and live with faith, good character and purpose.
